back: A one-page list: decision, actor, cost of error, horizon, granularity, refresh, today's baseline, success measure.

front: How to compute the minimum horizon?
back: Lead time plus review period. Forecasting less is useless; forecasting more adds cost without value.
Under-cost divided by the sum of under-cost and over-cost. Plan for that quantile of demand.

front: When is a forecast the wrong tool?
back: When no decision can change, when your action changes demand (needs causal or optimisation), or when a rule is enough.

front: What is the staff-level first question?
back: Which decision will change, who acts on it, and what does an error cost?

front: What does a one-page plan include?
back: Restated decision, size of the prize, one primary metric with guard-rails, a pilot slice with a stop rule, an owner.
